main_text.p: tot annos manifesto indicat, sententiam Latinorum, si facta non est approbatam fuisse; si additio facta est, etiam additionem veram, & rationabilem comprobatam fuisse ad tempora usque Sergij Patriarchæ.

Dicunt, hanc nullo modo a Photianis confictam, sed re ipsa, & Oecumenicam cum omnibus suis partibus fuisse, cum in ea præsentes adfuerint Photius Patriarcha Constantinopolitanus, Legati Pontificij Paulus, Eugenius, & Petrus, Locumtenentes reliquorum trium Patriarcharum, & Metropolitanorum, & Episcoporum, & aliorum non contemnendus numerus, & Imperator ipse Basilius cum filijs, eique assentientes subscripserint, nihilque in ea desideretur, quod Oecumenicam Synodum præfiniat.

Hoc vero postremum probandum est, quod nunquam planum fiet. In ea Pontificij Legati seducti mandata sibi a Pontifice data violant, quibus violatis ( sic præmonet Pontifex ) reliqua pro infectis habeantur. Patriarcharum aliorum Oratores minis, atque pollicitationibus sevocati votis Photij, atque Imperatoris cedunt: alij Metropolitæ, & Episcopi partim sunt mancipia Photij, partim palpatores pessimi, partim excommunicationibus ob sacros Canones læsos irre-titi

page.notes: Text is clear throughout. The page edge on both sides shows partial marks from the neighbouring page, not transcribed. "sevocati" is the printed form, with long s read as s and u/v normalised. "Basilius" appears printed as "Bafilius" (long s). Printed "fiet" and "Petrus" are as on the scan. The word split at the bottom is "irre-" / "titi" and is joined as printed with its hyphen. No catchword is printed.
